resources.string: Selected apps and sites are blocked only during the daily time window on the weekdays you choose, until the selected duration ends.

Choose what to block, which weekdays the block applies to, the daily time window, and the total duration. During the selected window the targets stay blocked; outside it they remain available. The commitment itself cannot be ended early.
Choose the weekdays, daily blocking hours, and how long the commitment should remain active.
Which days of the week do you want to block?
Blocking applies only on the selected days.
Select at least one day of the week.
What hours should blocking be active?
Apps and sites are blocked only between the start and end time. Overnight windows are supported.
Start and end time must be different.
How long should this schedule remain active?
